script: My 640‑lb secret finally exposed—my world collapsed after one donut.. Nobody believes me when I mention this online, I just desperately need somewhere to share this. I am 23 and my life is complete agony, honestly. I just ordered and ate eight donuts, and now I am spilling guilt like a broken record. I barely leave my bed anymore—pain and effort, bruh. The only folks who see me are delivery drivers; even opening the door feels like a marathon. My family hasn't seen me in nearly four years, and they keep begging me to fly and visit. I can't even imagine fitting on a plane, and I don't want them to see my body. I used living alone as an excuse to go straight into self‑destruct mode. I was 350 pounds the last time they saw me. I don't understand why I am still alive, honestly. I am in so much mental and physical agony that it feels like I am eating myself to death. I smell terrible—showering is a nightmare. I can't even fit in the tub, and I've been skipping showers for years. I am worried about my health but lack the motivation to do anything. I can't look at myself in the mirror; I am disgusted, and I hate everything about me. I am not suicidal, but the feeling that I am slowly killing myself is relentless. The audacity of it all, right? I keep telling myself I'll change, but the weight—literally 640 pounds—keeps pulling me down. And I am stuck in this cycle, feeling like I am the only one who can't escape it.
